name: document-index-mcp
description: Indexes documents on your computer so AI agents can retrieve only the relevant, source-located passages.
author: ekelly95
//private: Distribution is by cloning this repository, not npm — see the README's install section. `private` is the guard that makes an accidental `npm publish` fail rather than claim the name. `npm pack` still works, so CI's install-outside-the-checkout job does not need this removed. Drop it if the package is ever genuinely published.
//files: Runtime output plus the four documents a distributed copy has to carry: what it does, what changed, how to report a hole in it, and why its dependencies are licensed the way they are. Tests compile into dist/ because `pnpm test` runs them from there, so they are excluded by negation rather than by a separate build config.
//clean: tsc never deletes the .js belonging to a source file you removed, and the test script globs dist/. A deleted parser's tests therefore keep running, forever, against a build no source can reproduce — which is exactly what happened when EPUB and PPTX came out: six deleted test files kept passing and then failing from stale output. So every build wipes dist first. Inlined via node's own fs rather than adding a rimraf dependency; it is cross-platform either way.
